newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Pakterminal opens new wharf at Estonian port.
newsitem.headline: Pakterminal opens new wharf at Estonian port.

text.p: The Estonian-Dutch company Pakterminal opened a new 253-metre wharf for oil tankers at the Estonian port of Muuga on Tuesday, the company said in a statement.
The new wharf will enable the terminal's facilities to handle ships with up to 25,000 tonnes of displacement, Pakterminal said.
Pakterminal now has three wharfs operating at Muuga which can simultaneously load up to 80,000 tonnes of oil.
Five new containers with a capacity of 30,000 metres have also been put into operation by Pakterminal.
The total capacity of Pakterminal's containers is now 134,000 cubic metres.
Pakterminal has handled 2.2 million tonnes of oil products so far this year, five percent more than in calendar 1995, the company said.
